images.caption: Figure 1:Framework overview.(a) A frozen model uses Skill, Knowledge Memory, and MMKB to answer new cases. MMKB supports comparison with visual references and their source answers. (b) The optimizer proposes new Skills and supported knowledge additions from scored trajectories. The candidate update is tested on new and past cases before deployment, and validation feedback guides the next update.
